Trump Ordered to Testify in $10 Billion BBC Defamation Lawsuit

A U.S. judge has ordered former President Donald Trump to provide a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The lawsuit concerns the editing of a documentary about the January 6 Capitol riot.
